M01: Title "Chapter 1 · Choose to drive responsibly". Four distinct panels: M01-L02 "Readiness today": stationary teal car in legal parking bay, tired adult learner and supervisor speaking outside, keys on a bench, no medical diagnosis. M01-L03 "Pressure": two subframes within panel: cabin passenger speaking to learner, then distant rear view of teal car following slower white van in right-hand lane approaching a blind hill crest, no overtaking arrows. M01-L04 "Plan before leaving": adult inside home planning next to closed car keys, two window/weather inset alternatives daylight and heavy rain. M01-R "Your decision": neutral three small stills tired person, appointment clock, worsening weather; below blank space labelled "What would you change?". No licence/permit artwork; M01-L01 remains text only.
M02: Title "Chapter 2 · Prepare a car that is ready". Four distinct panels: M02-L01 "Learn the controls": stationary teal estate with adult beside open generic vehicle handbook, no readable dashboard or invented manual instructions. M02-L02 "Check before moving": rear three-quarter view of same stationary car attached to small empty trailer in parking area, another adult observes rear lamps from safe side; no glowing diagnosis indicators. M02-L03 "Protect passengers": adult and child standing outside open rear passenger door, empty rear-facing child-seat silhouette visible but NO belt-path or installation detail; caption "Use the vehicle and restraint instructions." M02-L04 "Keep observing": two matching top-down panels of teal car nose-in parked beside a tall white van; behind their rears a level footway, then a clear wide access lane. Pedestrian visible on right edge in first, obscured behind van in second from driver's view, no reversing path or assurance of sensor coverage. Footer note "M02-R uses the separate approved parking review design."
M07: Title "Chapter 7 · Adapt when conditions change". Five distinct panels: M07-L01 "Visibility": same Swedish road in heavy rain and darkness, teal car on RIGHT-hand side of road, reduced visible horizon. M07-L02 "Changing grip": dry foreground road before shaded potentially icy bend, no skid or speed guarantee. M07-L03 "Attention": close cabin view of adult safely PARKED in marked bay, hands-free conversation suggested by phone resting in holder with no readable screen and speech bubble ellipsis. M07-L04 "Change the plan": adults planning indoors beside window with heavy rain, teal car parked outside. M07-R "Review": four neutral small panels daylight departure, rain, darkness, delayed clock; below blank writing lines and "Explain your decision." Avoid signs, technical controls, arrows, and invented performance figures.
M03: Title "Chapter 3 · Read the road before acting". Five panels. M03-L01 "Read purpose first": teal learner car approaches a narrow rural bridge with oncoming white van, both on their right-hand sides; no signs drawn in scene, small separate blank swatch labelled "A5 / B6 / B7: exact official assets in final layout". M03-L02 "Read the whole situation": car stopped BEFORE a junction stop line, traffic light green but exit beyond intersection full of queued cars; intersection itself kept clear, no police gestures. M03-L03 "Plan the route early": driver in right-hand lane of multi-lane road, early choice before distant junction; separate inset of car continuing calmly past missed turning. Do not draw lane-change arrows or readable fabricated direction signs. M03-L04 "Time to respond": car approaching distant queue with clear gap; separate readable calculation box "50 km/h ÷ 3.6 ≈ 13.9 m/s. With an assumed 1 s delay: about 14 m before braking begins." Underline "Response distance only; braking distance is additional." M03-R "Review": neutral three mini-panels showing route choice, generic time-condition text card and green-signal queue, with empty answer lines. No answer overlays.
M08: Title "Chapter 8 · Take responsibility for the vehicle and load". Four panels. M08-L01 "Two separate checks": side view teal estate and trailer with editorial labels, no fake registration document: "Registered total weights: 2,200 kg + 1,500 kg = 3,700 kg". Caption "Check entitlement and technical limits separately." M08-L02 "Know the actual load": generic empty trailer and separate cargo boxes, explanatory text "400 kg ready weight + 500 kg cargo = 900 kg actual weight. Example towing limit: 800 kg." Caption "These are hypothetical figures, not a vehicle specification." Avoid showing a loaded trailer attached to a car or implying approved securing. M08-L04 "Assistance has limits": same teal car approaching temporary roadworks lane with plain cones and white lane markings, no dashboard icons, do not depict autonomy. M08-R "Review": neutral parked car and trailer with unloaded boxes nearby and three question labels "Entitlement?", "Actual weight?", "Towing limit?"; ample answer lines, no answers or numeric hints in this REVIEW panel. Footer note "M08-L03 remains a text checklist."
M09: Title "Chapter 9 · Reduce the impact of each journey". Four panels. M09-L02 "Look ahead": teal car remains behind a pedestrian crossing with a clear gap, distant queue beyond crossing, car is on right side of road, no generated road signs. M09-L03 "Combine the journey": schematic ORIGINAL itinerary, not a real map: one side Home–Shop–Home and Home–Library–Home drawn as simple nodes and connectors; other side Home–Shop–Library–Home; caption "Illustrative routes; compare the practical options." No numerical savings claim. M09-L04 "Check access before leaving": generic vehicle information booklet on desk beside a blank rectangular sign-insert area labelled "Official zone sign in final layout"; no city names, fake emissions certificate or invented zone instruction. M09-R "Review": neutral unselected alternatives Walking, Cycle, Public transport, Car, and a blank errands list; no green ticks or preferred choice. Footer note "M09-L01 uses a comparison table rather than decorative imagery."
M05: Title "Chapter 5 · Make room in busy streets". Three generous panels with NO educational answers supplied in review. M05-L01 "People near the bus": rear view on Swedish town street, bus stopped at right curb with LEFT amber turn indicator visible; learner teal car approaches behind with gap, pedestrians on footway near bus. A TEXT card outside image says "Example road limit: 50 km/h" (not a road sign). M05-L02 "Check the street's purpose": stationary learner car before pedestrian-street boundary with walking people beyond, a blank insert rectangle separate from scene labelled "Verified E7 sign in final layout". Do not draw sign or imply permission to enter. M05-R "Review": three neutral separate mini-panels: bus at curb, cyclist near doors of parked cars, overhead road with a crossing and empty approach space; prompt "What would you observe and check?" with blank lines. No distance labels, solution shading or traffic arrows. Footer note "M05-L03 uses D03 and D06; M05-L04 uses the parking observation sheet."
M06: Title "Chapter 6 · Travel beyond the town". Five panels. M06-L01 "Narrow road": teal car approaches narrow bridge, rock obstruction on its RIGHT-hand lane; oncoming white van stays in its lane; no overtaking or priority arrows. M06-L02 "Hidden view": teal car behind slower white van approaching left bend hidden by rock and trees; no passing path. M06-L03 "Join calmly": simple top-down same-direction acceleration lane RIGHT of main road, both vehicles point UP, teal joining car and ochre main-road car offset; inset car continues straight safely beyond missed exit, no late lane change. M06-L04 "Interrupted route": railway crossing with teal car stopped BEFORE tracks and queue BEYOND tracks; crossing remains entirely empty; adjacent separate roadworks image with plain orange cones, no invented signals or signs. M06-R "Review": four neutral mini-panels narrow rural road, obscured bend, junction choice, railway tracks with distant queue; answer lines, no arrows or predetermined outcome. Use no sign assets in these scenes.
M10: Title "Chapter 10 · Respond, reflect and keep learning". Four panels, contain NO graphic injuries and NO clinical procedures. M10-L01 "Location changes the response": three clearly separated scenes. A motorway: teal car on hard shoulder, occupants safely outside guardrail away from lanes, nobody repairing wheel, no fixed triangle distance shown. B non-urgent tunnel: car in protected emergency bay, no smoke, occupant seated inside calling assistance. C fire/urgent tunnel: smoke in far background and people walking away towards a visible doorway on protected walkway; no invented distance or safe-route arrow, no signs drawn (official E28/E29 inserted later). Exact caption "Different situations require different responses." M10-L02 "Call from a protected place": person behind barrier using phone, car incident in distant background, no injured bodies; speech card "112: location, direction, what happened, immediate dangers." M10-L03 "Explain a whole journey": neutral four mini-stills urban road, roundabout, rain, parking; no arrows/solutions. M10-R "Your journey": five EMPTY storyboard frames labelled "Start", "Traffic", "Conditions", "Unexpected stop", "Reflection", writing lines; do not fill in a correct answer. Footer "M10-L04 remains a readiness checklist. First aid: brief reference to 1177."
